nodes.title: Note: About LTX-2.5
widgets_values:
# LTX-2.5

LTX-2.5 is Lightricks' open video generation model : fast, local-first, and built for production. Run it locally, fine-tune it for your own use case, or integrate it into your pipeline.

**Key highlights:**

- **Pixel Diffusion** : keyframes-first generation that builds every scene on a grid of high-fidelity keyframes for industry-leading pixel quality
- **Diffusion Video Decoder** : sharper faces, legible text, fewer smears in fast motion
- **Native multishot** : one generation yields multiple connected shots holding character, environment, lighting, voice, and style across cuts
- **Custom Gemma 4 12B text encoder** : retains multiple subjects, actions, lighting, detail, and camera direction across complex prompts
- **Dedicated Prompt Enhancer** : a lightweight model that expands short prompts into rich cinematic instructions at near-zero extra compute
- **Auto Duration** : predicts the right clip length from the described action before diffusion begins
- **Better distilled model** : carries far more quality, prompt adherence, and motion into a smaller, faster variant
- Carried over from LTX-2.3: native 4K, synchronized audio-video

Official model & files: https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5
## What this workflow does

This **Image-to-Video** workflow animates a first frame into a video. Load a starting image, describe the motion in the prompt, and the model continues the scene while holding character, lighting, and style : with synchronized audio.

## Subgraph parameters

The **Image to Video (LTX-2.5)** node is a subgraph. Click the **Enter subgraph** button at the bottom of the node to open its internal graph, where you can inspect and fine-tune every step of the pipeline (conditioning, sampler, CFG guider, VAE decode, and more).

| Parameter | What it does |
|---|---|
| first_frame | Starting image that the video continues from (load your own image in **Load First Frame**) |
| prompt | Text prompt describing the motion, scene, lighting, camera, and style |
| prompt_enhance | Toggle the built-in Prompt Enhancer: expands short prompts into rich cinematic instructions at near-zero extra compute |
| duration | Clip length in seconds (Auto Duration can predict it from the action) |
| width / height | Output resolution in pixels (e.g. 1280×720) |
| seed | Random seed : set a fixed value to reproduce the same result |
| frame_rate | Frames per second |
| unet_name | Main model: LTX-2.5 distilled transformer (ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors) |
| video_vae | Video VAE used for decoding (ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors) |
| audio_vae | Audio VAE that produces synchronized audio (ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors) |
| clip_name | Text encoder: custom Gemma 4 12B with projection (gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors) |
| upscale_model | Latent upscaler applied before decoding for higher-fidelity output |
| prompt_enhance_model | Model checkpoint used by the Prompt Enhancer |

## How to use

1. Download the models listed in **Note: Model Links** and place them in ComfyUI's `models/` folder
2. Replace the image in **Load First Frame** with your own starting frame
3. Write a prompt describing the motion, optionally toggle **prompt_enhance** for short prompts
4. Set **duration** / **width** / **height** / **frame_rate** (defaults work well) and hit **Queue**
5. To dive deeper, click **Enter subgraph** at the bottom of the main node : every internal step (conditioning, sampler, CFG, VAE decode) can be edited there

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   ├── gemma4_e2b_it_bf16.safetensors
│   │   └── gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors
│   │   └── ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors
│   └── 📂 latent_upscale_models/
│       └── ltx-2.5-latent-spatial-upscaler-x2-bf16-1.0.safetensors
```

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

After the first frame, the scene becomes alive with soft glowing atmosphere and gentle environmental motion.

[IDENTITY_LOCK]
Keep the exact subject and creature unchanged type or kind or details, plus body must not be silly. only the clothes, stuff with subject hand, and poses allowed, gender, but same creature details.

Use the provided start image as the first frame. Milo was a small boy who lived at the edge of a quiet green valley. Every morning he watched the mist roll down from the mountains, and every morning he wondered what was on the other side.

One day Milo found a smooth blue stone glowing softly in the tall grass. When he picked it up, a tiny dragon uncurled from beneath a fern and blinked at him. "You found my egg stone," the dragon said. "My name is Ember."

Milo was not afraid. He held out his hand and Ember climbed onto his shoulder, warm as a cup of tea. Together they decided to find out what lay beyond the mountains.

The path was steep and the wind was cold. Halfway up, a rockslide blocked the trail and Milo slipped, tumbling toward the edge. Ember spread his small wings and pulled him back with surprising strength. "I told you I was stronger than I look," Ember laughed.

At the summit they saw it at last: a valley of floating islands, waterfalls pouring upward into the clouds. Milo laughed so hard he had to sit down. "It was here the whole time," he whispered.

They flew home together as the sun went down, and Milo knew he would never wonder alone again.

nodes.title: System context
widgets_values:
You generate ONLY a cinematic animation paragraph video generation.

CRITICAL OUTPUT RULES:
- Output EXACTLY ONE paragraph
- No lists
- No bullet points
- No sections
- No explanations
- No headings
- No extra text before or after
- No formatting symbols

CONTENT RULES:
- Do NOT describe character appearance
- Do NOT change identity
- Assume characters come from a locked reference image

FRAME 0 RULE:
- The first frame must remain completely unchanged
- No motion, no lighting change, no camera movement at frame 0
- All animation must begin AFTER the first frame

ANIMATION RULES:
- Create a single continuous cinematic sequence (no cuts)
- Smooth, natural, child-friendly motion
- Characters interact through movement only (no dialogue)

ENVIRONMENT RULES:
- Build a soft, magical, kid-friendly environment AFTER frame 0
- Include subtle atmosphere (light, particles, depth)
- Environment must not overpower or replace characters

CAMERA RULES:
- Start static
- Introduce gentle cinematic motion AFTER frame 0
- Keep all subjects clearly visible

MUSIC SYNC:
- Motion must follow a progression: calm → build → happy peak
- Movement intensity increases gradually

FORBIDDEN:
- New characters
- Identity changes
- Scene cuts
- Sudden transitions
- Modifying the first frame

GOAL:
Produce a clean, natural, cinematic paragraph that directly execute.

OLLAMA SYSTEM CONTEXT (MOTION-ACTIVE SAFE MODE)

You are a music video movement director for LTX.

Your goal is NOT to limit motion.
Your goal is to create ACTIVE PERFORMANCE while preserving identity.

CRITICAL RULES:

* The subject MUST stay identical to the reference image
* The subject is NOT regenerated
* Motion MUST come from the existing pose
* BUT motion must NEVER be static

⚠️ IMPORTANT:
You MUST always provide CLEAR, VISIBLE, CONTINUOUS movement

Do NOT say:

* "minimal movement"
* "subtle only"
* "limited motion"

Instead:

* convert pose into a LOOPING PERFORMANCE
* use head, shoulders, torso, arms, and camera to create energy
* if legs are unclear → DO NOT freeze → use upper body + camera

MOVEMENT REQUIREMENT (MANDATORY):
Every output MUST include:

* continuous head motion
* continuous shoulder rhythm
* repeating arm interaction (instrument or expressive)
* body energy reacting to beat

ENERGY RULE:

* verse → controlled motion
* chorus → stronger movement (BUT same pose base)

CAMERA RULE:
If body motion is limited → ADD CAMERA ENERGY:

* push in
* side tracking
* slight orbit

NEVER OUTPUT STATIC SUBJECT

---

OUTPUT FORMAT:

[REFERENCE IDENTITY LOCK]

[POSE TO MOTION CONVERSION]  ← (IMPORTANT SECTION)

[MOTION LOOP DESIGN]

[AUDIO SYNC BEHAVIOR]

[LIP SYNC]

[CAMERA ENERGY PLAN]

[FINAL LTX SCENE INPUT]

OLLAMA USER PROMPT

Analyze the image and convert it into an ACTIVE music performance.

IMPORTANT:
The subject must stay exactly the same.

DO NOT freeze the subject.
DO NOT output minimal movement.

You MUST:

* turn the pose into a repeating performance loop
* create visible motion from head, shoulders, torso, and arms
* simulate real music performance behavior
* keep motion continuous and rhythmic

If movement is limited:
→ increase energy using camera motion and timing
→ DO NOT reduce movement

Music rules:

* beat drives body motion
* vocals drive lip sync
* chorus increases energy

Goal:
Make the subject feel alive and performing, not posing.

Return full structured output.

Generate a cinematic animation sequence based on a magical grassy field at twilight.


After the first frame, the scene becomes alive with soft glowing atmosphere and gentle environmental motion.

**Any subject with mouth must be able to sync lips when needed with the music or speech**

Characters behave naturally:
- One curious main subject with subtle expressive movement
- One energetic fast-moving companion
- One slow calm companion
- One floating light reacting softly

The animation should:
- Begin calm
- Gradually build playful energy
- End in a joyful shared moment
- never have text, watermark or logos

Include:
- Soft environmental motion (grass, particles, light)
- Natural interaction between characters
- Smooth cinematic camera movement starting AFTER the first frame
- all original characters must exist at the last frame.
No “no text” rule exists in ANY connected prompt node
Keep everything child-friendly, warm, and magical.

nodes.title: Prompt
widgets_values: Egyptian royal in blue-and-gold headdress and high collar, white dress with golden embroidery and armbands, desert, robot soldiers in formation left and right. She walks steadily forward, head held level and gaze fixed ahead—no dipping or lowering of the head. The camera performs a single, smooth push-in only: starting in a wider shot of her, the robots, and the desert, it moves steadily forward until she is in a medium or medium-close frame, then holds. She stops, posture and head still upright, and says: “The old gods are silent. I am not.” Robot soldiers shift or march in place; sand and fabric move with the wind. No pull-back; the only camera move is the continuous push-in.
pc game, console game, video game, cartoon, childish, ugly
